formula.ascii: SLRM = verticalExaggeration * (z_centre - mean of z over the (2r+1)^2 window), r = radius in pixels (no cell size involved). Window coordinates outside the raster replicate the edge pixel (numpy pad edge, so an edge sample may count several times); invalid samples are excluded from both the sum and the count N; an invalid centre gives NaN. Computed as -total/N with total = sum(z_j - z_c), from an exact 64-bit summed-area table (quantum 2^-16) or the separable row/column filter on very large grids.
